messages:
marina: Heads-up — seeing a spike in fncall schema rejects for toolhook on eu-west canary, ~3% of requests over the last 10m.

ravi: ack, do we have a breakdown by route_id and validator name?

sam: quick glance: most rejects tagged as "missing_required_field" from validator:fn_output_shape. route_id ~ experiments/voice-assist.

marina: yep. curious thing: telemetry sampling for validator events is at 0.05 so console counts are noisy. we probably undercount soft-fallbacks.

olivia: UX question — when we surface rejects in the rollout dashboard, should we show sampled raw payloads or redact by default? security asked for redaction.

ravi: redact by default, but include a hashed fingerprint and a sample link w/ access controls. we need deterministic bucketing so devs can repro.

sam: for short term ops: suggest bump validation sampling to 100% for route experiments/voice-assist for 15m so we can triage. also add a tag "reject_reason" to trace spans.

marina: +1. can someone propose the exact config change? i can run it if we agree.

ravi: change: ```validators.fncall.sample_rate = 1.0 // for service:toolhook route:experiments/voice-assist``` also add telemetry: ```span.tags += ["validator.name", "validator.reason", "route_id", "model_variant"]```

olivia: add UI flag too: dashboard should show "validation sample rate" and last-applied change with actor. helps rollout audits.

marina: i'll open a short-lived PR to patch the canary policy and add the tag. will also add a follow-up card to product backlog for dashboard flag.

sam: note on quotas: when a validator rejects and triggers fallback, some requests reroute to degen path which consumes a different quota bucket and is getting charged. ops pls monitor billing drift while we're sampling.

ravi: good call. tagging idea: include "billing.route_bucket" tag on fallback hops so finance can query.

marina: deploy-bot, toggle validators sampling for route experiments/voice-assist to 1.0 for 15m (reason: schema triage).

deploy-bot: @marina request accepted. Sampling rate for validators.fncall on route experiments/voice-assist set to 1.0. Auto-revert scheduled in 900s. Change recorded by marina at 1722003459.

olivia: thanks. once we have samples, can we run the simple parser-fix in staging and shadow for 1h?

marina: yes — plan: collect 15m samples, analyze, patch adapter to coerce optional fields, run shadow, then canary patch.

sam: i'll wire an alert on billing.daily_degen_consumption if it increases >10% from baseline during the window.

ravi: small follow-up: let's ensure console logs also include validator.score where available — helps rank flaky validators.

marina: noted. i'll include validator.score in the telemetry PR.

olivia: create a short postmortem template entry even if root cause is trivial — keeps rollout audit clear.

marina: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
